tei:div.tei:p: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: ye shes ḍā ki'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs: e ma ho: chos nyid snang ba dag pa'i zhing khams nas: nyams snang gong 'phel pad+ma saṃ bha wa: rig pa tshad phebs ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: blo 'das gnyug ma'i ngang du gsol ba 'debasaḥ chos nyid ye grol dgongs pa mngon gyur nas: 'ja' lus gzhon nu bum skur grol bar shog: ces mkha' 'gro'i gsol 'debs 'di yang pad+ma rdo rje'i bzhed skong du su kha'i ming gis rdzun ris su bris pa'o// dge'o// nyams byung skor las bar do'i mthong snang nges 'byung gsal sgron bzhugs/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs// 'jigs pa kun skyobs 'phags ma sgrol// 'gro ba'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung*// yongs 'dus drin chen bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// bdag dang bar do'i sems can rnams// las snang 'khrul pa'i 'jigs las skyobs/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ lar 'gro ba rigs drug sdug bsngal che// sgos 496)bar do'i snang ba ya re nga*// las gang byas rang gi lus la smin// nor longs spyod che yang khyer dbang med// pho dpa' rtsal ldan kyang 'thab sa med// gtam kha lce mkhas kyang bshad sa med// mi g.yo can sems rtsa 'gul sa med// gnyen nye 'brel dpung rogs khrid sa med// rang gcig pur skyabs bral mgon med du// las dge sdig gnyis kyi rnam smin khur// ya nga ba'i gnas su 'khyams nas 'gro// las bde sdug gnyis las myong rgyu med// skyabs dkon mchog gsum las re sa med/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ las snang 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams// bar do'i snang ba shar ba'i dus// las rlung drag pos rgyab nas ded// gshin che'i pho nyas mdun nas bsu// gshin lam 'phrang ring 'grim pa'i tshe// rang gis las bsags dbang gis ni// bzod med sdug 'di 'dra myong*// la la lcags sreg ser bas bcom// la la rlung dmar drag pos ded// la la gshin che'i pho nyas ded// sod rgyob 'ur sgra chem chem byed// mtshon cha sna tshogs lus la gdab/

497)/mi bzod sdug bsngal du ma myong*/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ skyabs dkon mchog gsum dang spyan ras gzigs// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung*// don dbyor med drin chen bla ma mkhyen// yid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// spyir 'gro ba yongs la thugs rjes zungs// sgos bar do'i sems can bskyab tu gsol// las bsags pa'i rnam smin lus la 'khor// mtshon cha mang pos bcad gtub byed// sdug bsngal du mas rtag tu mnar/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ de nas mi chung dkar nag dang*// 'phrad skabs bdag gis 'di skad smras/ mi med yul nas mi gnyis byung*/ khyed gnyis gang du 'gro ba yin// nyes med skye 'gro mtshams 'di nas cung zad chad dam snyam/ yun cig bsdad tshe snang ba 'gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ kye ma/ nyams thag 'gro ba 'di nas kyang cung zad chad dam snyam/ don gnyis 'grub pa'i lus mchog thob par shog ces dang ma ṇi lan gsum gyi rjes su kun gyis khas len ci 'grub re byas mthar bsngo ba ni/ bdag gzhan rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs 498)ci mchis pa thams cad drin chen pha ma rnams kyis gtsor byas pa'i ri la gnas pa'i ri dwags/ chu la gnas pa'i srog chags/ sa la gnas pa'i 'bu srin/ brag la gnas pa'i bya rigs/ mdzo mo mang po'i rto le/ che ba lag gis bsad tshad/ chung rkang 'og la bsad pa/ rig ma rig la bsad pa/ sha sna brgya zos pa/ khrag sna stong 'thung ba/ dkar 'o zho 'thung ba/ dmar sha khrag zos pa/ 'og rta 'gel mdzo la sogs rgyu zas kha lag gi 'brel thogs bsngo gang dgos rnams kyis gtsor byas pa'i khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug la gnas pa'i sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i phyir du bsngo/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ

lan gsum mthar/ kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen man chad dang*/ sogs smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ zhes pa 'di'ang rang lo nyer gcig lor snang nyams shar ba'i skor las khol du phyungs te/ rigs kyi myu gu chos dbyings sgron ma dang rang slob dad dam ldan pa shes rab sgron ma gnyis kyis 'dod don nan cher bskul ba la brten nas rang gzhan la phan pa'i blos kun bzang chos nyid dbang mos cung zad khrigs su bsdebs nas sa mo yos 499) kyi lor bris pa 'dis kyang khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho dong nas sprug nus pa'i rgyur gyur cig dge'o// kye ho/ spang ljongs dben pa'i gnas na// sngon smon las kyis 'brel ba'i// gser ldan ngang khyu pha mo// lha ldan khu byug nga dang*// 'brel zab cung zad che yang*// gnas tshang brag la bca' ba'i// thang dkar rgod po'i gshog 'gyur// spu gri'i rno las ngar che/ khu byug nus pa chung bas// bzod thabs med pa'i dbang gis// skabs rer gnas yul gzhan du// grang lhag sdug bsngal che yang*// mi 'gro 'dug thabs ma byung*// dri bral dar dkar lta bu'i// blo sems bsam pa dkar po/ khyed cag rnams la 'chang bas// dben rir sgrub tshugs zungs la// grogs ngan dbang du ma gtong*// sgo gsum cos min ma byed/ khu byug snying gi thig pa// yang zab man ngag zab mo// nyams len gnad la rem mdzod// shar gyir rta bdun dbang pos// spu gri'i rno ngar gzhom na// ngang ngur khyu dang 'grogs nas// gshog rtsal ngal dub che yang*// yid mthun khyed cag bsam nas/ 500)/dus med dus su slebs 'ong*// de bar rang gzhan don du// spyod lam tshul bzhin zhib dgos// spang ljongs yid dga' med na/ khu byug brten pa'i gnas bral// a la ku re yin no// mi 'gyangs myur du mjal 'ong*/ zhes rigs mthun gyi rig rgod// sher lha yis bskul nas/ rigs ngan gyi rgan mos// a mtshar du smras so/

dus 'dzin sa yos lor rang yul 'khyar la 'gro skabs rang slob shes rab lha mo la bde ba'i rdo rjes gdams pa'o// sngon 'brel las kyis bsdus pa'i// snying 'dra'i bu slob rnams nyon// shar gyi khu byug sngon mo// las 'phro'i stobs kyis bskul nas// lho phyogs mun pa'i khrod la// sngon smon stobs kyis 'phangs song*// stag seng dpa' rtsal ldan pas// yul de'i mun pa sel byed// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu// 'dzam gling spyi yi rgyan gcig /'od kyis mun kun sel nas/ khyung 'brug thang dkar ngang khyus// rang skal nor la spyod nas// don gnyis 'od brgya 'gyed byung*// spang ljongs gzi mdangs ngom nas// g.yu drug ngar skad sgrogs dus/ khu byug rang yul snyegs 501)bsam// 'on kyang nub kyi nyi zlas// skabs skabs bshol ma byed 'dug /de ltar stabs ldan med tshe/ gser gyi rwa rtse ngoms dus/ lho nas shar du rgyu nges// de bar nges pa med pas// gnas tshang brag la bca' ba'i// thang dkar thang smug tshogs kyis// sngar gyi dam bca' bzhin du// rang skal gdams par longs spyod// rtsal gsum lus la rdzogs tshe// gnam 'phang gcod la ngal med// de ltar tshig min dpe yin// nges med yul kun nyul ba'i/ khu byung ma bu'i tshogs kyis// yid mthun bya tshogs rnams la// nges don nges pa'i gtam 'di// sgyu ma'i tshig ris 'di nyid// dus gsum bya ba'i gnas tshul// sba gsang med par gus phul// dpyod ldan rnams kyis dpyod dang*// dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs// dpyid ka'i nyi ma 'gro thabs// dpyad kyang i shes ma go /dpyod shes rab tu mkhas na// drang nges gnyis kyi gtam yod// byung dang 'byung 'gyur thams cad// gab gsang med par zhus yod/ ha ha/ rgan mo'i smyo gtam mtshar glu/ ho ho/ gang shar yig ris bris nas/ he he/ bu slob rnams la gus phul/ dge'o//
